mechanism: Fluconazole inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, reducing cenobamate metabolism and increasing its plasma concentrations, while cenobamate induces CYP3A4, potentially reducing fluconazole efficacy.
action: Monitor cenobamate levels and clinical response; consider cenobamate dose reduction if toxicity signs emerge; verify fluconazole efficacy for fungal infection treatment.
